title: 第七章、特殊积木，黑红浮空伞
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

随着阴森诡谲的声音响起，场上众人不约而同醒来，眼神迷离看向四周围。

“哎呀，你别推我，我快被你推倒。”

“谁踩老头子脚，给我站出来。”

“对不起兄弟，我不是故意的，刚才落地没站稳，不小心往你那边倒了。”

“我看你就是故意的，不然这么大位置，你不往别处倒，非得往我这边倒。”

“不是，你真误会，我不是故意的。”

双方立马发生冲动，场面变得极为混乱。

端木棠梨作为号召大伙出面的人，只能站出来当这个临时大队长。

“安静，既然大伙听我话来到这里博一条出路，那么接下来听我指挥。”

端木棠梨说完这句话，场面寂静，没人发表意见，她都不知道这些人是赞成，还是反对。

还是米樱昭雪机灵，站出给小姐妹捧场。

“有请大小姐出场，带领我们赢得这次胜利。”

“对，让我们用最热情的掌声欢迎大小姐出场。”

米樱昭雪说完，米樱闻笙跟着附和，热情洋溢鼓掌起来。

其他人你看看我，我看看你，跟着稀稀拉拉鼓起掌。

啪啪啪~

掌声不算大，还很乱，但好在端木棠梨看到在场十个人都在鼓掌，说明他们都赞成自己做领导人，这就够了。

“既然大伙都相信我，那现在大伙都自我介绍一番，方便等会安排任务。”

“我先来，你们大伙应该都认识我，我是大小姐的小仆人小雪，人称大姐大。”

米樱昭雪第一个站出来自我介绍，随后是米樱闻笙，“我叫阿笙，大小姐是我主子，大姐大是我姐。”

由米樱昭雪和米樱闻笙开头，其他人精神勉强放松下来，纷纷做自我介绍。

“田佳，自由职业，想吃水果找我。”

一个穿着短袖短裤的中年女子站出来说话，因为家里人也是做水果行列，端木棠梨对于中年女子有种本能的亲切感。

“我叫梦煜，是一名律师，这是我妹妹梦雨，是个在校大学生，这是我姐姐梦怡，目前在考公务员。”

Page (1/3)

As the eerie voice sounded, everyone on the scene woke up at the same time, looking around with blurred eyes.

"Oh, don't push me. I'm about to be pushed down by you."

"Whoever steps on the old man's toes should stand up for me."

"I'm sorry, brother. I didn't mean to do it. I didn't stand firm when I landed on the ground and accidentally fell towards you."

"I think you did it on purpose. Otherwise, in such a big position, you would have to fall to me if you didn't fall somewhere else."

"No, you really misunderstood, I didn't mean it."

The two sides immediately became excited and the scene became extremely chaotic.

As the person who called everyone to come forward, Duanmu Tangli could only stand up and become the temporary captain.

"Quiet, since everyone listened to me and came here to find a way out, then follow my command."

After Duanmu Tangli said this, the scene was silent and no one expressed an opinion. She didn't know whether these people were in favor or against.

It was Miying Zhaoxue who was smart and stood up to support the little sisters.

"Miss, please come on and lead us to win this victory."

"Yes, let us welcome the eldest lady to the stage with the warmest applause."

After Mi Ying Zhaoxue finished speaking, Mi Ying Wen Sheng echoed and clapped enthusiastically.

Others, you look at me, I look at you, and they applaud sparsely.

Bang bang bang~

The applause was not loud, it was still chaotic, but fortunately Duanmu Tangli saw that all ten people present were applauding, which showed that they all agreed with him being a leader, and that was enough.

"Since everyone trusts me, let's introduce ourselves now so that we can arrange tasks later."

"I'll come first. You all should know me. I'm Xiaoxue, the eldest lady's servant. I'm known as eldest sister."

Mi Ying Zhaoxue was the first to stand up and introduce herself, followed by Mi Ying Wen Sheng, "My name is A Sheng, the eldest lady is my master, and the eldest sister is my sister."

Starting with Miying Zhaoxue and Miying Wensheng, the others barely relaxed and introduced themselves one after another.

"Tian Jia, freelancer, come to me if you want to eat fruit."

A middle-aged woman wearing short-sleeved shorts stood up to speak. Because her family also worked in the fruit industry, Duanmu Tangli had an instinctive affinity for middle-aged women.

"My name is Mengyu, and I am a lawyer. This is my sister Mengyu, who is a college student. This is my sister Mengyi, who is currently taking the civil service examination."
